newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish airline hunger strikers lament bad service.
newsitem.headline: Spanish airline hunger strikers lament bad service.

text.p: Baggage handlers at Spain's Iberia airline declared a hunger strike in Ibiza on Friday, complaining that cost-saving cutbacks in their hours have forced them to give poor service to tourists visiting the holiday isle.

Vicente Cardona, a spokesman for the 18 strikers, said they were demanding a longer work week after the airline cut their hours to 20. All the workers are on temporary contracts for the May-October high tourist season and are paid by the hour.
"They have cut back our hours to save money and now they do not have enough people working in Ibiza," Cardona said. "We are giving bad service to our customers," he added.
An Iberia official in Ibiza confirmed that the handlers were staging a hunger strike.
The protesters are still hefting suitcases at Ibiza's airport while drinking only water. The Mediterranean island is a popular tourist destination.
